content.short: FLOQ is a licensed Indonesian crypto investment platform supervised by the OJK.
content.description: FLOQ is a crypto asset investment platform in Indonesia, licensed and supervised by the country's Financial Services Authority (OJK). World's official World Chain ecosystem directory lists it as a centralized exchange. Local licensing is what allows an exchange to serve retail users in a regulated market like Indonesia.
content.meta: FLOQ is a licensed, OJK-supervised Indonesian crypto investment platform, listed for World Chain.
